paper.title_en: Carroll-Cotton Tensors and Gravitational Radiation at Null Infinity
paper.abstract_en: We provide a first-principles definition of Cotton tensors on conformal Carroll geometries by gauging the conformal Carroll algebra. On the mathematical side, this analysis yields a conformally covariant object designed to quantify deviations from conformal flatness in Carrollian geometries. On the physical side, it offers a powerful geometric tool to describe gravitational radiative degrees of freedom at the conformal boundary of four-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetimes. Unlike the Bondi news, whose fully-covariant definition requires amendment by supplementary data that we identify with the Geroch tensor, the Carroll-Cotton tensors offer the natural geometric objects to quantify deviations from stationarity due to the emission of gravitational waves.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文为引力辐射和渐近平坦时空的几何描述提供了新的数学工具（Carroll-Cotton张量），与广义相对论基础领域高度相关，理论深度和原创性突出。
decision.title_zh: Carroll-Cotton张量与无穷远处的引力辐射
decision.abstract_zh: 我们通过对共形Carroll代数进行规范，给出了共形Carroll几何上Cotton张量的第一性原理定义。在数学方面，这一分析产生了一个共形协变的对象，旨在量化Carroll几何中偏离共形平坦性的程度。在物理方面，它为描述四维渐近平坦时空中共形边界处的引力辐射自由度提供了一个强大的几何工具。与Bondi新闻不同，其全协变定义需要通过我们识别为Geroch张量的补充数据来修正，而Carroll-Cotton张量则提供了自然的几何对象来量化由于引力波发射而导致的偏离平稳性。
